ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Voice control could be useful alongside my Fire TV devices, though I would check compatibility first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K, so this older model offers little reason to buy another.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on home viewing and security equipment and have no current need for a tablet.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing 4K stick already covers streaming and better suits my 4K television.
ItemID: NA; Title: NETGEAR Wi-Fi Range Extender EX2700 - Coverage Up to 800 Sq Ft and 10 devices with N300 Wireless Signal Booster & Repeater (Up to 300Mbps Speed), and Compact Wall Plug Design; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would consider this if my cameras had connection problems, but I have no established need for extra coverage.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Storage could be useful for recording, but I would need to confirm device compatibility and a storage need before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet with Alexa Hands-Free, 10.1" 1080p Full HD Display, 32 GB, Marine Blue (Previous Generation - 7th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A portable screen is not a priority when my recent purchases center on television and cameras.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This looks useful for connecting my Fire TV Recast to my 4K television, with extra length for placement.
ItemID: NA; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for wired earbuds; they do not support the home viewing or security setup I am building.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa compatibility is relevant, but I do not currently have a specific appliance I want to automate.
